## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Hook type must be a registered webhook type (gitea, gogs, or registered requester) | validation | !webhook_service.IsValidHookTaskType(form.Type) |
| Hook config must contain 'url' and 'content_type' keys | validation | form.Config missing 'url' or 'content_type' |
| Hook content_type must be 'json' or 'form' | validation | !webhook.IsValidHookContentType(form.Config["content_type"]) |
| Hook URL must be a valid URL | validation | !validation.IsValidURL(form.Config["url"]) |
| Slack hooks require a valid channel name in config | validation | w.Type == webhook_module.SLACK && channel missing or invalid |
| Default events to 'push' if no events specified | business_logic | len(events) == 0 |
| Authorization header is encrypted before storage using setting.SecretKey | business_logic | cleartext != "" |
